title: What Carries Architectural Signal? A Code-to-Architecture Mapping Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.41628v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Code-to-architecture mapping assigns source files to modules of a reference architecture. Representations of implementation artifacts can capture code text, dependencies, and directory organization, but predictive gains alone do not establish the contribution of additional graph processing. Dependencies may already be encoded in these representations, while directories may closely match the reference decomposition. We investigate how artifact representations and graph context affect mapping on ten Java, C, and C++ systems with a limited labeling budget. We compare lexical, structural, and contextual file representations and assess each predictor with and without dependency neighbors. Using a Heterogeneous Graph Transformer (HGT), we compare file-level graphs extended with member nodes summarizing each file's program elements, folder nodes, or both, alongside a variant encoding folder paths directly in file representations. translated_title: 什么承载了架构信号？一项代码到架构映射研究
translated_abstract: 代码到架构映射是将源文件分配到参考架构各模块的任务。实现制品的表示可以捕获代码文本、依赖关系和目录组织，但仅凭预测性能的提升并不能证明额外图处理的贡献——依赖关系可能已经编码在这些表示之中，而目录结构可能与参考分解高度吻合。我们在十个标注预算有限的 Java、C 和 C++ 系统上，研究了制品表示与图上下文如何影响映射效果。我们比较了词汇、结构和上下文三类文件表示，并在有、无依赖邻居的情况下分别评估每个预测器。基于异构图Transformer（HGT），我们比较了通过概括每个文件程序元素的成员节点、文件夹节点或二者同时扩展的文件级图，并对比了直接在文件表示中编码文件夹路径的变体。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究系统性地探究了代码到架构映射中究竟是哪些因素——文件表示类型、依赖邻居、文件夹路径或成员节点——真正承载了架构信号，指出依赖与目录信息可能已隐含在文件表示中，额外的图处理未必带来实质增益。
